verdicts.reason: A is close to a uniform scale of the original, which works here because the aspect ratios are nearly the same. Hierarchy, reading order, logo size and spacing all survive, though it inherits the orphaned 'long.' and the body copy is small. B shrinks the FIZZBANG! logo pill until it is tiny and puts '$3' above '2 FOR', so the offer reads backwards. It also squeezes the body copy into tiny type on one line and inflates the 'Find a Store' button until it competes with the price. On top of that, a large dead gap sits between the copy and the CTA.
